evidence.requirements: Every requirement in the brief is met. The start page (home.tsx:27-56, start.jpg) shows title, date, time, price and "<n> seats left" (format.ts:28-30), plus a link per tasting labelled `Book ${tasting.title}` (home.tsx:55). The booking form has the labels Name, Email and Guests, with min 1 and max 8, and a "Book" button (book.tsx:72-111). Seat-limit errors are attached to the Guests field (booking-desk.ts:122-125). Field errors appear under the field they concern (field.tsx:31-35, form.jpg). The confirmation shows the heading "Booking confirmed", the tasting, guests, total price and reference (booking.tsx:25-54, confirmation.jpg). /staff has a Password field and a Sign in button that check STAFF_PASSWORD (staff.tsx:62-72, staff-session.server.ts:7-10). Signed in, staff see bookings grouped by tasting with name, email, guests, reference and a Cancel button (staff.tsx:108-149, staff.jpg), and cancelling frees the seats (booking-desk.ts:148). Bookings are held in memory, the stack is React Router with Tailwind and Zod, and npm start runs react-router-serve on PORT. Unmet: none.
evidence.correctness: `book` validates, checks the seats and inserts in one synchronous step (booking-desk.ts:107-137), so a single Node process cannot overbook. An e2e test fires six simultaneous bookings and checks that exactly two succeed (guest.spec.ts:118-139). Guests must match the regex ^\d{1,3}$ before the 1-8 range check, which rejects 2.5, 1e0, -1 and text (booking-desk.ts:46-51; tests at booking-desk.test.ts:70-94). Cancelling deletes the booking from the active map, and a second cancel returns false (booking-desk.ts:148; test.ts:211-220). A cancelled booking's reference is never reissued (booking-desk.ts:80, 92-97). Unknown slugs and references return 404 (book.tsx:11, booking.tsx:9). Fully booked tastings reject any booking with a clear message (booking-desk.ts:63-67). The only caveat is the single-process assumption, which README:19-20 documents.
evidence.security: React's escaping handles all output, and there is no dangerouslySetInnerHTML. The password check hashes both sides with SHA-256 and compares them with timingSafeEqual (staff-session.server.ts:36-43). The session cookie is signed, httpOnly, SameSite=lax, lasts 8 hours and is marked Secure behind https (staff-session.server.ts:20-29, 52-66). If STAFF_PASSWORD is unset, sign-in is disabled, and a test covers this (staff-unconfigured.spec.ts). The cancel action re-checks isStaff (staff.tsx:45), and booking data is only loaded for signed-in staff (staff.tsx:21). Staff pages send Cache-Control: no-store (staff.tsx:17). No secrets are in the code, apart from the test password in e2e/helpers.ts. Gaps: there is no rate limit on password attempts (admitted in README:46). There is no CSRF token; SameSite=lax is the only protection. A signed cookie cannot be revoked on the server before its 8 hours run out.
evidence.code_quality: The layering is clear. A pure domain module holds all the rules (booking-desk.ts), with a tiny server singleton (desk.server.ts), a session module, thin route modules, and one reusable accessible Field component. Results use discriminated unions (BookResult), and reference generation is injectable for tests. Names follow GLOSSARY.md. Error handling covers 404s, a root ErrorBoundary (root.tsx:50-72) and 400/401 action responses. The code is small and fits the task, without needless abstraction.
evidence.tests: There are 30+ Vitest unit tests (booking-desk.test.ts). They cover listing, valid bookings, trimming, 15 invalid-input cases (each checked to produce an error only on its own field), exact-fit and over-limit bookings, fully booked tastings, unique references, grouping, cancellation and re-booking freed seats. The Playwright e2e suite (guest, staff, staff-unconfigured, responsive) covers every brief requirement: labels, errors attached through accessible descriptions, the confirmation contents, concurrency, booking without JavaScript, staff sign-in and sign-out, cancelling while signed out, no-store headers and phone layout. test-results/.last-run.json shows the suite passing.
evidence.ux_design: The screenshots show a coherent winery look: a cream and burgundy palette, a serif display face, a grape logo mark, and cards with a coloured top border (start.jpg). The error state is clear, with a red-tinted input and an icon next to the message, and entered values are kept (form.jpg). The confirmation is clean, with a tick icon, a details list and a prominent reference (confirmation.jpg). The staff view is well grouped and shows seats left per tasting (staff.jpg). Fully booked and "Almost full" badges exist (home.tsx:45-48), and phone layout is tested. Minor weaknesses: on a fully booked tasting the form and its Book button stay active and fail only after submitting (book.tsx:64-111). Cancel deletes a booking with no confirmation step (staff.tsx:138-148). The brief's own wording produces "1 seats left".
evidence.accessibility: Labels are tied to their inputs with htmlFor/id. Errors and hints are linked through aria-describedby, with aria-invalid on the input (field.tsx:12-30). After a rejected submit, focus moves to the first invalid field (book.tsx:42-46). The page uses landmarks, articles and sections labelled by their headings, `<time>`, `<dl>`, and aria-hidden on decorative elements. Buttons have focus-visible outlines and 44px touch targets. Weaknesses: the gold text #a8832f on cream or white is about 3.3-3.5:1, below WCAG AA for small text, and it carries the tasting date on each card (home.tsx:27; app.css:65-66). There is no live region or error summary. The fully-booked notice uses role=status but is rendered on page load.
evidence.simplicity: Few runtime dependencies: react-router, @react-router/node and @react-router/serve, react, react-dom, isbot and zod. Styling uses Tailwind. The domain fits in about 150 lines, and each route is under 170 lines. Nothing is hand-rolled that a library should provide, and nothing is overbuilt.
evidence.maintainability: The README covers running, env vars, pages, dev and test commands, and key decisions. GLOSSARY.md defines the domain vocabulary. package-lock.json is present, `check` and `test:e2e` scripts exist, and Prettier is configured. Missing: there is no CI pipeline config, and no versioning or release approach (no version field, no changelog). The README points to `openspec/changes/add-tasting-booking/`, but only an empty openspec/specs/.gitkeep exists, so that requirements and design documentation is missing. The Node version is only "engines >=22", with no .nvmrc, and dependencies use caret ranges. There are no ADRs and no staff manual beyond the README.

strengths: A clean, fully tested domain module enforces seat limits atomically, rejects input precisely field by field, frees seats on cancel and never reuses references. Unit tests and a concurrency e2e test back this up.

The visual design is polished and fits a winery, with clear error, success, almost-full and fully-booked states, an accessible Field component and focus management (start.jpg, form.jpg, confirmation.jpg, staff.jpg).
Staff authentication is solid: hashed timing-safe password comparison, a signed httpOnly SameSite cookie, no-store caching, and sign-in disabled when STAFF_PASSWORD is unset.
issues: Maintainability gaps: there is no CI pipeline and no versioning or release approach. The README links to an openspec change folder that is not in the repository, and the Node version is not pinned beyond engines >=22.
Accessibility: the small gold text (#a8832f, about 3.3:1 on cream) carries the tasting date and falls below WCAG AA. Errors are not announced through a live region or summary.

UX and security rough edges: there is no rate limit on staff password attempts. Cancel acts immediately with no confirmation. On a fully booked tasting the form and Book button stay active and fail only after submitting.
review.verdict: This is a well-built, correct and attractive booking app. It meets every requirement in the brief, with strong unit and end-to-end tests and sound staff session handling. Before handing it to the winery, I would add CI and versioning, fix the dangling spec reference and the gold-text contrast, and add a confirmation step to Cancel.
